sec-bot: [ALERT] 1809504320 - Unusual outbound auth activity detected from inference-gw-23 (10.4.8.23). 42 failed token exchanges, 7 successful, destination IPs show high entropy (suspicious).
Ops Pager: Paging oncall SRE: @Amelia (SRE) — incident created: INVEST-1809504321.
Amelia (SRE): Ack, looking. grabbing logs and flow info.
Amelia (SRE): Quick ask — any customer-facing errors?
Sanjay (Platform): No 5xx spikes on API gateway. Latency small uptick on private pool, could be retries.
Michael (Security): On it. Can you paste the destination IPs? I'll check threat intel.
Amelia (SRE): dests: 3.120.45.9, 18.67.200.11, 52.12.221.7 — pattern: same /24 over different ports.
Michael (Security): 3.120.45.9 flagged in previous scanning lists. Suspect exfil probes.
Amelia (SRE): Found a small set of recent logs in /var/log/inference/access.log that include bearer tokens in query params — immediately redacting and exporting to secure bucket. Example snippet (redacted):
```
GET /v1/generate?api_key=sk-live-REDACTED HTTP/1.1
Host: internal-inference
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
```
Sanjay (Platform): Oh no. That looks like a service token. Which service?
Amelia (SRE): Token appears tied to svc-internal-ml (read-only?), cross-checking with token DB now.
deploy-bot: [deploy] 1809505000 - Can confirm svc tokens rotated 1809400000, policy is 30d.
Amelia (SRE): Token last rotated 45 days ago — it missed rotation. Probably a human-side credential pasted into an internal debug link that got picked up by external scanner.
Michael (Security): Immediate actions: 1) Revoke the exposed token(s). 2) Rotate any related service account credentials. 3) Block outbound connections to the suspicious IPs at VPC firewall. 4) Start customer impact assessment.
Amelia (SRE): Doing 1 and 3 now. Running revocation: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/tokens/revoke -d '{"token":"sk-live-REDACTED"}'`
Amelia (SRE): Firewall rule applied to block 3.120.45.0/24 and 52.12.221.0/24 at edge egress ACL (temporary).
Sanjay (Platform): Kicking off automated rotation for svc-internal-ml, will force rollout to dedicated nodes. ETA ~8m.
Ops Pager: Noted. Logging actions for postmortem.
Michael (Security): I started a quick audit of tokens with read/write scopes across last 72h. If any token with broad scopes was used, escalate to incident level 2.
Amelia (SRE): No immediate evidence of data exfil from object store metrics — egress bytes normal for that window. But logs with tokens may have been scraped by probe.
Sanjay (Platform): Customer-facing: no errors reported from customer incidents dashboard. We should still prep a notification template in case of confirmed exposure.
Michael (Security): Agreed. Drafting notification: include rotated token IDs, affected services, and mitigation steps.
Amelia (SRE): Adding canary checks: disable svc-internal-ml in staging first to ensure rollout won't break live.
deploy-bot: [info] 1809506500 - rotation job started for svc-internal-ml (job id rot-1809506500).
Amelia (SRE): rotation job completed, new tokens issued and injected. Confirming no restart-required services failed.
Sanjay (Platform): Just kicked a rolling restart on the private pool to pick up new creds. Slow traffic drain on nodes in 3AZs.
Michael (Security): Threat intel: 18.67.200.11 is tied to a scanning cluster known for credential scraping. Flagged attacker group: unknown. Adding IOCs to blocklist.
Amelia (SRE): Ops check: no user-facing errors, no token usage post-revocation. Monitoring for retries and retry storms.
Michael (Security): Next steps: full token audit, rotate any non-compliant tokens, update secrets scanning rules to catch tokens in query string and add regex for our token formats.
Sanjay (Platform): I'll open an internal PR to add query-string scanning in the ingress pipeline (WAF rule) and a lint rule in devdocs to forbid tokens in URLs.
Amelia (SRE): Preparing incident handoff to Security oncall. I'll mark this incident as "mitigated" for immediate customer impact but we'll keep it open for post-rotation validation and follow-ups.
Michael (Security): I'll take lead on post-incident investigation and coordinate with Trust & Safety on potential external notifications.
Ops Pager: Incident INVEST-1809504321 — status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handoff to Security for deep dive.
Amelia (SRE): Notes for postmortem: root cause human paste of token into debug GET, missed rotation alert, insufficient query-string scanning. Remediation actions: 1) force-rotate policy checks, 2) add WAF rule, 3) developer training + lint, 4) add alert for tokens in logs.
Michael (Security): Adding action: embargoed indicator sharing with partners, update SLA page if customer impact > 0.
Sanjay (Platform): I'll schedule a 1hr follow-up meeting with Platform + SRE + Security tomorrow to review rollout and WAF changes.
Amelia (SRE): Thanks all. Leaving monitoring on for 24h, will update INVEST ticket with timestamps and artifacts. :white_check_mark:
